description: The work waiting to be taken, across every room: each task with its room. A room is a conversation around making and closing tasks, and a ready one is specified well enough to finish without asking - what it is, what done looks like, and the links it needs. This is how a person carries work out of a room and into whichever assistant they work in: take one, do it there, then PATCH its status to done. -- MakeHybrid API plan, GET /rooms/work/ready, group rooms.

query.description: Optional query-string parameters, e.g. {"limit":"20","cursor":"..."}. Values are coerced to strings.
